about: Vallarith's Life Cards (dungeon/life/cards.py, docs/life-cards.md): events drawn into town days, roads, rests and off-page beats with the seeded dice. `chance` is the odds in percent that a scene draws anything, by drama level (0 quiet, 1 uneasy, 2 eventful, 3 merciless); `drama` is the lowest level a card turns up at; `intensity` is the level each category must be at for the card to happen; `topics` are veil topics; `truth` is the hidden fact, `seen` what the character perceives and `accuracy` how far to trust it; `effects` are for code. The d100 tables follow Prospero's Study's Encounter, Obstacle, Foreshadowing, Direct Challenge, Opportunity and Hooks tables, which Companion's everyday tables left out.

cards.title: Bad water
cards.truth: A cistern in {town} went foul from a dead dog wedged in the outflow.
cards.seen: Half the street says the {faction} poisoned the well. Folk are drinking ale at breakfast rather than draw water.

cards.title: Hanging day
cards.truth: {town} hanged three men for stealing grain from the tithe barn. One of them never touched it.
cards.seen: Three men hanged in the square at noon. The crowd ate pies and threw the crusts at the bodies.
cards.pressure: The quietest one's wife stops strangers in the street to ask who really took the grain.

cards.title: Cheap bread
cards.truth: A grain barge from Eriane came in early and flooded the market.
cards.seen: Bread is cheap this week. Even the beggars by the gate have whole loaves.

cards.title: The tithe comes early
cards.truth: The lord's men came a month early for the war tithe, because the lord lost at cards.
cards.seen: Soldiers are going door to door for the war tithe, a month early. A house that can't pay gives a son to Bastion.
cards.pressure: A widow on your street asks you to hide her boy in your room until they've gone.

cards.title: The bonesetter drinks
cards.truth: The only bonesetter in {town} has been drinking since his daughter died of the flux.
cards.seen: The bonesetter's hands shake until his first cup. After the third they shake again, worse.

cards.title: A purse in the straw
cards.truth: {pc} found a purse hidden in a stable's straw. It belongs to a man who has killed over less.
cards.seen: You found a fat purse tucked into a stable's straw. Nobody has come asking for it. Yet.
cards.pressure: Spend it, or find out whose it was before he finds out who has it.

cards.title: Crystal under the cellar
cards.truth: A cooper found a vein of crystallized Ley under his cellar and told his brother, who told everyone.
cards.seen: Everybody is talking about the cooper's cellar. Men with picks have started knocking on his door after dark.

cards.title: The man in grey
cards.truth: A Brotherhood of Man speaker is buying Ley-gifted children for the schools in Trein. Few of them write home.
cards.seen: A smiling man in grey is paying parents good silver to send their gifted children to school in Trein.
cards.pressure: A mother asks you whether the schools are real.

cards.title: Fever in the lower town
cards.truth: Sweating fever came in on a barge crew. It takes the old first.
cards.seen: The lower town has chalk crosses on the doors. The watch won't go in, and the priests charge to.

cards.title: Bad tincture
cards.truth: The apothecary cut his willow tincture with lamp oil to stretch it. Three of his customers have gone blind.
cards.seen: The apothecary's tincture smells of the lamp. Someone outside his shop is shouting about his eyes.

cards.title: A duel at dawn
cards.truth: Two merchant sons fought over a debt and the loser bled out. His family blames the winner's second, {npc}.
cards.seen: A young man died on the green this morning. His family has hired men to find {npc}.
cards.pressure: {npc} begs you to get them out of {town} before nightfall.

cards.title: A priest of Girione
cards.truth: A halfling priest of Girione is setting bones for free, paid for with coin he skims from his bishop.
cards.seen: A halfling priest is setting bones for free behind the temple of Girione. The queue goes round the block.

cards.title: The press gang
cards.truth: A press gang is working the taverns to fill the levy for the Asanian front.
cards.seen: Men are going missing from the taverns after dark. Their friends say the army took them.
cards.pressure: A drunk you shared a table with last night is being dragged off by his collar.

cards.title: Your debt was sold
cards.truth: {pc}'s creditor sold the debt on to a moneylender who collects with knives.
cards.seen: A stranger knows exactly what you owe and to whom. He says you owe him now, and he's less patient.

cards.title: A married interest
cards.truth: {npc}, married and bored, has decided to have {pc} and is arranging it.
cards.seen: {npc} keeps finding reasons to be wherever you are. Their spouse has started finding reasons too.

cards.title: The madam's book
cards.truth: The bathhouse madam kept a book of which officials visit and what they pay for. Someone stole it.
cards.seen: The bathhouse madam is offering a fortune for a missing book, and won't say what's written in it.

cards.title: Ears for silver
cards.truth: Bastion pays a bounty on gnoll ears. Some hunters have started cutting them off half-orc farmhands.
cards.seen: Bounty men are cashing in ears at the garrison. A half-orc farmhand from the east road hasn't come home.
cards.pressure: The farmhand's mother asks you to find him.

cards.title: A small thief
cards.truth: A thin girl lifted {pc}'s purse for a gang boss who beats the children who come back empty.
cards.seen: Your purse is gone. You remember a thin girl bumping you near the fish stalls.
cards.pressure: When you find her, she has bruises that weren't there this morning.

cards.title: A funeral feast
cards.truth: A rich family buried their grandfather and fed half of {town} to show they could.
cards.seen: There's free food at the merchant's funeral. Nobody at the tables looks sad.

cards.title: They want a witch
cards.truth: A run of stillbirths has the parish hunting for a witch. The likeliest target is the Ley-gifted midwife who caught most of those babies.
cards.seen: There's a crowd outside the midwife's house with torches, and a priest who won't look anyone in the eye.
cards.pressure: Stand with her, or let the crowd have her.

cards.title: A fair offer
cards.truth: A devil of Mammon's court, dressed as a moneylender, is buying souls in {town}, one desperate family at a time.
cards.seen: A soft-spoken lender gives loans with no interest at all. He asks only that you sign in your own blood.
cards.pressure: Someone you like has already signed.

cards.title: Nicana's statue
cards.truth: A drunk soldier hacked the face off Nicana's statue on a bet.
cards.seen: Nicana's statue in the square has no face this morning. The priests say Aveus's faithful did it.

cards.title: Strength night
cards.truth: The faithful of Aveus hold pit fights under the tannery. The loser serves the winner for a year.
cards.seen: Someone pressed a token into your hand: a black fist, an hour, and the word tannery.
cards.pressure: The purse is a year's wages. So is the price of losing.

cards.title: What {bond} owes
cards.truth: {bond} lost money at dice to a man who now wants it back in favors, starting with {pc}.
cards.seen: {bond} has been jumpy for days and won't say why. A man you don't know keeps waving at them.

cards.title: Something {bond} did
cards.truth: Years ago {bond} sold a friend to the watch to save their own neck. Drink brought it out.
cards.seen: Late and drunk, {bond} tells you about a friend they sold to the watch, and asks if you'd have done the same.

cards.title: {bond} goes cold
cards.truth: {bond} saw {pc} with {npc} and decided it meant more than it did.
cards.seen: {bond} is short with you today and won't say why.

cards.title: Your face on the wall
cards.truth: The watch posted a bounty on {pc}, with a sketch that gets the scar on the wrong side.
cards.seen: A watchman is nailing up a sketch of you by the gate. It's a poor likeness. For now.

cards.title: The fence is talking
cards.truth: The watch raided the fence's shop, and he's giving them names to keep his hands.
cards.seen: The fence's shop is boarded up. His wife says he's at the barracks, and that he's talking.

cards.title: Harvest fair
cards.truth: Eriane's harvest fair brought wine, fiddlers and every pickpocket in the kingdom.
cards.seen: There are fiddlers in every square and the wine is nearly free. Keep a hand on your purse.

cards.title: Bread riot
cards.truth: The bakers' guild hoarded grain to lift the price. The crowd burned their hall, and the watch answered with crossbows.
cards.seen: The bakers' guild hall is burning and there are bodies in the street. The watch fired into the crowd.

cards.title: The veteran
cards.truth: The legless beggar at the gate ran from Adlmyr a week before it fell. He lost his legs to frostbite in a ditch.
cards.seen: A legless beggar at the gate tells anyone who'll listen how he lost his legs holding Adlmyr's wall.

cards.title: A letter from home
cards.truth: {pc}'s parent is dying, and the land goes to whichever child is at the bedside when they go.
cards.seen: A letter from home, three weeks old: your parent is dying, and your brother has already moved in.

cards.title: Chained in the square
cards.truth: Slavers from the south sold a coffle of war captives in the square. The town charter allows it.
cards.seen: A line of chained people is being auctioned by the well. Some still wear Cyrel's colors.
cards.pressure: One of them knows your name and says it loudly.

cards.title: A real cook
cards.truth: A cook from Mordun took over the tavern kitchen. Her pepper stew is worth the walk.
cards.seen: People are walking across {town} for the new cook's pepper stew, and the tavern is warm and loud.

cards.title: The lamps go dim
cards.truth: Crystal mining in the hills has thinned the local Ley, and spells are failing at the edges.
cards.seen: The ward lamps keep guttering, and the hedge witch says her charms have gone weak this month.

cards.title: Picks under the floor
cards.truth: A cult believes a piece of Asmodeus lies under {town} and has been tunneling beneath the old church.
cards.seen: Folk on Church Lane hear picks under their floors at night. The priest says it's rats.

cards.title: The muse
cards.truth: {npc}, a painter, has caught the Leanan Sidhe's eye. The work is brilliant and it is killing them.
cards.seen: {npc}'s paintings sell for more every week. They haven't eaten or slept in days, and they're happy.

cards.title: Ley dust
cards.truth: Someone is selling crushed Ley crystal to snort. It makes a user feel like a god for an hour and burns out the nose and the nerve.
cards.seen: Half the dock hands have red-rimmed nostrils and bright eyes. They call it a pinch of the Font.

cards.title: The rent doubles
cards.truth: A soldier offered the landlord twice the rent for {pc}'s room, and the landlord took it.
cards.seen: Your landlord wants double the rent by the end of the week, or the room goes to a soldier.

cards.title: Short weight
cards.truth: The grain seller's weights are shaved, and {pc} has been paying for air.
cards.seen: The sack of meal you bought is light. The seller swears on Girione's name it isn't.

cards.title: Deserters
cards.truth: Five deserters from Bastion, starving, mean to rob the next traveler and are ashamed of it.
cards.seen: Five ragged men in army boots block the road. Their leader asks, almost politely, for your purse.
cards.pressure: Feed them, fight them, or turn them in for the bounty.

cards.title: The hanging oak
cards.truth: Toll-takers hanged a merchant family from a roadside oak as a lesson for anyone who doesn't pay.
cards.seen: Four bodies hang from an oak by the road, a board nailed under them: PAY.

cards.title: Pilgrims
cards.truth: Pilgrims bound for Benzaiten share their fire and their food and ask nothing back.
cards.seen: A band of pilgrims waves you over to their fire. They have bread and a kettle on.

cards.title: A burned farm
cards.truth: Unguruk raiders burned the farm two days ago and took the stock. The farmer's son is hiding in the well.
cards.seen: The farmhouse is ash. Something down the well is crying.

cards.title: Hounds on the wind
cards.truth: The Erlking rides tonight, and the Wild Hunt takes whoever runs.
cards.seen: Black hounds are baying somewhere above the trees, and the horses won't go on.
cards.pressure: Run, hide, or stand still and hope.

cards.title: The toll bridge
cards.truth: A minor lord doubled his bridge toll to pay his war levy. His men pocket half.
cards.seen: The toll on the bridge is double what the last traveler told you. The men collecting it are bored and armed.

cards.title: A dead courier
cards.truth: A courier lies dead in the ditch with sealed letters for the {faction}. His killers missed them.
cards.seen: A courier's body in the ditch, still warm. His satchel holds letters under a seal you know.

cards.title: Gnoll sign
cards.truth: A Dramogon hunting party is shadowing the road, looking for stragglers.
cards.seen: Gnoll tracks cross the road twice in an hour. Something laughs, a long way off.

cards.title: A broken axle
cards.truth: A Mordun merchant's wagon has a broken axle. He pays well for help, and better for silence about his cargo.
cards.seen: A merchant waves you down beside a tilted wagon. His crates clink, and they hum.

cards.title: Black sails
cards.truth: Dreadfall Corsairs raided a coastal hamlet and took everyone strong enough to row.
cards.seen: Smoke over the hamlet ahead, and a black-sailed ship pulling out past the point.

cards.title: A wayside shrine
cards.truth: A shrine to Tidum holds offerings of coin, bread and a good knife. Taking them angers no god, only the poor who left them.
cards.seen: A moss-grown shrine to Tidum, heaped with offerings. Nobody is watching.
cards.pressure: Take what you need, or leave it.

cards.title: Refugees
cards.truth: Families fleeing the Asanian front clog the road, and a cough is running through them.
cards.seen: A column of refugees fills the road for a mile. They ask for water, and some of them are coughing.

cards.title: Glass rain
cards.truth: A surge in the local Ley crystallized the rain into fine shards.
cards.seen: The rain turns to glittering grit that cuts, and the air hums like a struck bell.

cards.title: Someone on your trail
cards.truth: A bounty hunter has picked up {pc}'s trail and is a day behind.
cards.seen: An innkeeper mentions a man was asking after you yesterday. He paid for the answer.

cards.title: The empty waystation
cards.truth: The waystation is abandoned. Its well is sweet, and smugglers left a stash in the cellar.
cards.seen: An abandoned waystation with a good well. The cellar door has a new lock.

cards.title: An empty village
cards.truth: Ghouls took the village one family at a time. They sleep in the cellars by day.
cards.seen: Doors open, tables set, nobody home. The bread on the tables is green.

cards.title: A caravan needs guards
cards.truth: A caravan master lost two guards to fever and needs swords to the next town.
cards.seen: A caravan master offers you a week's pay to ride with his wagons to the next town.

cards.title: Kadragar traders
cards.truth: Kadragar goblins are selling salt fish and stolen Cyrellian swords cheap.
cards.seen: Goblin traders have laid out salt fish and a rack of good swords. One still has a dead man's name on the grip.

cards.title: A Stoneheart patrol
cards.truth: A Stoneheart patrol is checking papers. Travelers without them are turned back, or held.
cards.seen: Dwarves in blue-enameled mail stop you at the pass and ask to see your papers.

cards.title: To the marsh
cards.truth: Vymnommyth's faithful are marching a bound outsider into the swamp as an offering.
cards.seen: Dwarves in black scale cloaks drag a bound man toward the marsh. He is shouting in your language.

cards.title: Eyes past the fire
cards.truth: A hungry pack has been following the smell of the cookpot.
cards.seen: Eyes shine past the firelight, low to the ground, more of them every time you look.

cards.title: Light fingers
cards.truth: Someone crept into camp in the small hours and took food and a knife.
cards.seen: You wake to find a pack slit open, the bread gone and the good knife with it.

cards.title: The same dream
cards.truth: {pc} dreamed of a heart beating under the earth. Others who sleep near the pieces of Asmodeus dream it too.
cards.seen: You dreamed of a heart beating somewhere under the ground. When you wake, you can still feel it.

cards.title: A clear night
cards.truth: A clear, still night. {pc} sleeps well for once.
cards.seen: The stars are out, nothing stirs, and you wake rested.

cards.title: Talk by the fire
cards.truth: {bond} talked late into the night about home and the people they left there.
cards.seen: {bond} talks late into the night about home. It's the most you've heard them say.

cards.title: Wet boots
cards.truth: {bond} left camp to meet someone they don't want {pc} to know about.
cards.seen: {bond}'s bedroll is cold an hour before dawn. They come back with wet boots and no story.

cards.title: Soaked through
cards.truth: Rain all night. Nothing stays dry.
cards.seen: It rains all night. The fire dies, and so does the bread.

cards.title: A stranger at the fire
cards.truth: A woman asking to share the fire is a scout for a bandit crew, counting the gear.
cards.seen: A woman asks to share your fire. She's good company, and she asks a lot about where you're headed.

cards.title: Knives in the dark
cards.truth: Bandits followed the camp's smoke and came in at the darkest hour.
cards.seen: Someone trips over the guy rope, swears, and then there are knives everywhere.

cards.title: The dead get up
cards.truth: The camp sits on an old battlefield, and Orcus's touch has stirred what's buried there.
cards.seen: The ground moves under your bedroll. Then a hand comes up through it.

cards.title: A voice in the trees
cards.truth: An Unseelie lure is trying to draw {pc} out of camp with the voice of someone they love.
cards.seen: Someone you love is calling your name from the trees. They can't possibly be here.

cards.title: Killing cold
cards.truth: The temperature fell hard after dark, and the fuel ran out before dawn.
cards.seen: The cold gets into your bones and stays. Your fingers won't close properly until noon.

cards.title: Swamp fever
cards.truth: Bashrat's midges carry a shaking fever.
cards.seen: You wake shaking and soaked, though the night was warm.

cards.title: The watch slept
cards.truth: Whoever had the watch fell asleep. Nothing came, this time.
cards.seen: You wake at dawn and the one on watch is snoring, spear in their lap.

cards.title: Against the cold
cards.truth: {bond} crawled into {pc}'s blankets against the cold, and didn't leave when it warmed.
cards.seen: Sometime in the night {bond} crawls under your blankets for the warmth. They're still there at dawn.

cards.title: Knifed in a brawl
cards.truth: {them} took a knife in a tavern brawl and is laid up with it.
cards.seen: Word is {them} got cut in some tavern fight. Nobody agrees on how bad.

cards.title: Killed for their boots
cards.truth: {them} was murdered on the road for their boots and purse.
cards.seen: A traveler mentions a body by the road with no boots. The description sounds like {them}.

cards.title: Taken
cards.truth: {them} was taken by slavers and sold south.
cards.seen: Nobody has seen {them} in a week. Their door was found standing open.

cards.title: Bought
cards.truth: The {faction} paid {them} to report on {pc}, and {them} took the money.
cards.seen: Someone mentions {them} has come into money lately, and bought a good coat.

cards.title: Steady work
cards.truth: {them} landed steady work and a dry room.
cards.seen: Someone says {them} is doing well these days.

cards.title: Robbed in their sleep
cards.truth: {them} was robbed of everything they owned while they slept off a drink.
cards.seen: Someone says {them} is sleeping in a stable since they lost their purse.

cards.title: Turned out
cards.truth: {them} lost their place when their master's nephew wanted it.
cards.seen: Word is {them} is out of work and looking for anything that pays.

cards.title: A new lover
cards.truth: {them} has taken up with {npc}.
cards.seen: Word is {them} is sharing a bed with {npc}, of all people.

cards.title: Borrowed against tomorrow
cards.truth: {them} borrowed heavily from a man who doesn't forgive.
cards.seen: Someone saw {them} going into the moneylender's twice in one week.

cards.title: Grey robes
cards.truth: {them} joined the Brotherhood of Man and gave it everything they own.
cards.seen: {them} has been seen in grey robes, handing out pamphlets in the square.

cards.title: A seal on the palm
cards.truth: {them} signed a devil's contract to save someone they love.
cards.seen: {them} has a new scar on their palm, shaped like a wax seal, and they keep that hand closed.

cards.title: Out of the fire
cards.truth: {them} pulled two children out of a burning house and is the talk of the town.
cards.seen: Everyone is telling the story of {them} and the burning house, and it grows each time.

cards.title: Called an informer
cards.truth: {them} has done nothing, but a rival spread word that they inform for the watch.
cards.seen: People are saying {them} informs for the watch.

cards.title: Fever
cards.truth: {them} has the sweating fever.
cards.seen: Someone says {them} is sick. Someone else says dying.

cards.title: Danced away
cards.truth: {them} stepped into a fey ring and can't find the way back. Time runs strangely where they are.
cards.seen: {them} is missing. A shepherd saw them dancing alone in a field at dusk, to no music.

cards.title: A score settled
cards.truth: {them} found the man who ruined their family and killed him in his own kitchen.
cards.seen: Word is {them} is wanted for a killing.

cards.title: Pressed
cards.truth: {them} was pressed into the levy and marched to the front.
cards.seen: {them}'s landlady says soldiers came for them. She kept their things, and their rent.

cards.title: What you said
cards.truth: {them} heard that {pc} mocked them behind their back. {pc} never said it.
cards.seen: {them} has heard something about you. Whatever it was, you didn't say it.

cards.title: A slow letter
cards.truth: {them} wrote to {pc}. The letter will arrive late, and opened.
cards.seen: A letter from {them} reaches you, weeks old. The seal has been lifted and pressed back down.

cards.title: The thief-taker
cards.truth: {them} lost a hand to a thief-taker's justice for a theft someone else did.
cards.seen: {them} has a stump where their left hand was. They don't talk about it.

cards.title: Out of the chains
cards.truth: {them} got out. It cost them two fingers and a guard's life.
cards.seen: A ragged figure who looks a lot like {them} was seen on the north road, heading your way.

cards.title: A pinch of the Font
cards.truth: {them} has taken to Ley dust and is spending everything on it.
cards.seen: {them} has red-rimmed eyes and a new laugh, and owes money all over town.

cards.title: Married for money
cards.truth: {them} married a rich widow twice their age for her warehouse.
cards.seen: {them} is married. To money, by the sound of it.

cards.title: Hung out to dry
cards.truth: The {faction} sold {them} to the watch to cover its own tracks.
cards.seen: {them} is in the cells, and the {faction} says it has never heard of them.

cards.title: Your secret
cards.truth: {them} found out what {pc} has been hiding, and is deciding what it's worth.
cards.seen: {them} has been asking odd questions about where you were last spring.

cards.title: Rising
cards.truth: {them} rose in the {faction} and now has people of their own.
cards.seen: Word is {them} has a title now, and a pair of bodyguards.

cards.title: They named you
cards.truth: Facing the rope, {them} gave the watch {pc}'s name to save their own neck.
cards.seen: {them} walked out of the cells free, and the watch is asking about you.

cards.title: Something under the Heartwood
cards.truth: Something under the Heartwood reached up through {pc}'s sleep and offered them what they want most. Part of them said yes.
cards.seen: {pc} wakes with sap under their nails and iron in their mouth, from a dream of an open hand that offered everything.

rows.title: A tinker
rows.truth: A Wrenspire tinker selling clockwork mousetraps and two-week-old news.
rows.seen: A gnome with a cart of clockwork mousetraps falls in beside you, talking.

rows.title: A patrol
rows.truth: A Cyrel patrol wants papers, and a coin for not looking at them too closely.
rows.seen: Soldiers stop you and ask for papers. Their sergeant rubs his thumb and finger together.

rows.title: A priest walking alone
rows.truth: A priest of Witarr walks to bury the dead of a village with no priest.
rows.seen: A blond priest with an Abyss tattoo on his arm asks to walk with you as far as the crossroads.

rows.title: A wedding party
rows.truth: A farm wedding is walking from the temple, drunk and generous.
rows.seen: A wedding party spills across the road and won't let you pass without a cup.

rows.title: A mourning cart
rows.truth: The coffin on the cart holds stolen Ley crystal, not a body.
rows.seen: A cart carries a coffin. The mourners are armed and keep looking back the way they came.

rows.title: Driven cattle
rows.truth: The men driving the herd stole it from a farm you passed yesterday.
rows.seen: Four riders drive thirty head of cattle hard down the road. Nobody returns your greeting.

rows.title: A runaway
rows.truth: A half-elf woman is running from a Brynwyr marriage her family sold her into.
rows.seen: A half-elf woman with a good cloak and no luggage asks if she can walk with you.
rows.pressure: Riders with her family's colors are a day behind.

rows.title: Gnoll exiles
rows.truth: Gnolls cast out of Dramogon are starving and want to trade, not fight.
rows.seen: Three thin gnolls stand off the road with their hands open, holding out a pelt.

rows.title: A chain gang
rows.truth: Convicts mend the road under the lash. Half of them are debtors, not thieves.
rows.seen: Men in chains break stones on the roadside. The overseer's whip has a lead tip.

rows.title: A witch-finder
rows.truth: A witch-finder hunts the Ley-gifted for a bounty from the parish.
rows.seen: A man in a wide hat asks if you've met anyone who makes candles light without flint.

rows.title: A washed-out ford
rows.truth: Rain upstream took the ford.
rows.seen: The ford is a brown torrent today.

rows.title: A lame horse
rows.truth: A stone bruise. The horse needs a day.
rows.seen: Your horse is favoring a foreleg.

rows.title: A fallen tree
rows.truth: A storm-felled oak blocks the road.
rows.seen: An oak lies across the road, roots and all.

rows.title: The wrong fork
rows.truth: The milestone was turned around, on purpose.
rows.seen: By noon you realise the road is going the wrong way.

rows.title: Bad water
rows.truth: The stream is fouled by a dead animal upstream.
rows.seen: The water tastes of iron and something worse. Your gut agrees.

rows.title: A rockslide
rows.truth: Loose scree came down the cut.
rows.seen: The hillside comes down with a roar.

rows.title: Ley-sick ground
rows.truth: A mined-out vein nearby makes spells misfire.
rows.seen: Your magic feels slippery here, and the grass grows in spirals.

rows.title: Fog
rows.truth: Fog off the low ground. Nothing to do but wait or risk it.
rows.seen: Fog comes down so thick you can't see your own boots.

rows.title: Sucking bog
rows.truth: The causeway sank in the wet season.
rows.seen: The path drops into black bog to the knee.

rows.title: A burned bridge
rows.truth: Someone burned the bridge to slow whoever is behind them.
rows.seen: The bridge is charred stumps, still smoking.

rows.title: Crows over the hill
rows.truth: There was a battle over the hill two days ago.
rows.seen: Crows by the hundred circle something over the next hill.

rows.title: Fresh graves
rows.truth: A family buried its dead by the road and moved on.
rows.seen: Five fresh graves by the road, marked with sticks.

rows.title: A trampled banner
rows.truth: A Cyrel company was routed here.
rows.seen: A Cyrel banner lies trampled into the mud.

rows.title: Claw marks
rows.truth: Something large marks its ground on these trees.
rows.seen: Deep claw marks on the trees, higher than you can reach.

rows.title: A warning cairn
rows.truth: The cairn marks Unguruk ground. Crossing it means a fight.
rows.seen: A cairn of stones topped with an orc-carved skull.

rows.title: Glass trees
rows.truth: Ley crystallized in the wood. The vein underneath is worth a fortune.
rows.seen: A stand of birches has turned partly to glass, and it chimes in the wind.

rows.title: A boot in the road
rows.truth: A patrol lost a man here to something that eats.
rows.seen: A soldier's boot lies in the road. There's still a foot in it.

rows.title: An overturned cart
rows.truth: Raiders hit a family cart here. Nobody came back for it.
rows.seen: An overturned cart, a doll in the mud beside it.

rows.title: Smoke on the horizon
rows.truth: A village is burning a day's walk on.
rows.seen: A column of black smoke stands on the horizon ahead.

rows.title: Red mile marker
rows.truth: Aveus's faithful paint their meeting places red.
rows.seen: Someone has painted the mile marker blood red, and recently.

rows.title: Bandits
rows.truth: Bandits working the road for anyone alone.
rows.seen: Men step out of the trees with crossbows.

rows.title: A gnoll pack
rows.truth: A Dramogon pack hunts the road.
rows.seen: Laughter in the brush, closing on both sides.

rows.title: An orc war band
rows.truth: An Unguruk war band rides for the border.
rows.seen: Drums, and dust, and riders.

rows.title: An owlbear
rows.truth: An owlbear guards a kill near the road.
rows.seen: A hoot, then a roar that shakes the leaves.

rows.title: Ghouls
rows.truth: Ghouls from a fallen village hunt at dusk.
rows.seen: Grey shapes on all fours, moving too fast.

rows.title: Deserters
rows.truth: Deserters with nothing to lose.
rows.seen: Ragged men in army boots draw steel.

rows.title: A shore party
rows.truth: Dreadfall Corsairs ashore for water and captives.
rows.seen: A longboat on the beach, and men with hooks coming up the dunes.

rows.title: A troll under the bridge
rows.truth: A troll has made the bridge its larder.
rows.seen: The bridge planks are gnawed.

rows.title: Bounty men
rows.truth: Hunters after the price on {pc}'s head.
rows.seen: Three riders, and one holds up your likeness.

rows.title: A collector
rows.truth: A devil come to collect on a contract, and not fussy whose.
rows.seen: A man in a fine coat waits in the road. His shadow has horns.

rows.title: An abandoned pack
rows.truth: A pack dropped in a hurry.
rows.seen: A pack in the ditch, still full.

rows.title: A Ley crystal
rows.truth: A thumb-sized crystal washed out of the bank.
rows.seen: Something glints in the stream bed.

rows.title: A good camp
rows.truth: A dry, hidden hollow with a spring.
rows.seen: A sheltered hollow with clean water.

rows.title: A dead knight's sword
rows.truth: A knight died here alone. The sword is good steel.
rows.seen: A skeleton in rusted mail still holds a fine sword.

rows.title: Wild honey
rows.truth: A hive in a hollow tree.
rows.seen: Bees in a dead oak, and the smell of honey.

rows.title: A shortcut
rows.truth: A drover's track saves half a day.
rows.seen: A shepherd points you to a faster track.

rows.title: A smuggler cache
rows.truth: Smugglers cache coin under a marked stone.
rows.seen: A stone with a chalk mark, loose.

rows.title: A kind farmer
rows.truth: A farmer shares what little she has.
rows.seen: A farmer waves you in for soup.

rows.title: Healing herbs
rows.truth: Woundwort grows thick by the stream.
rows.seen: You spot woundwort along the bank.

rows.title: A scrap of map
rows.truth: A map scrap marks a cache in Adlmyr's old armory.
rows.seen: A scrap of map in a dead man's boot, with an X near Adlmyr.

rows.title: The only witness
rows.truth: {pc} is the only one who saw {npc} push the reeve's son into the river.
rows.seen: You saw {npc} push the reeve's son into the river. Nobody else did.

rows.title: Paid in a crime
rows.truth: Someone {pc} owes wants the debt paid in a crime.
rows.seen: An old creditor wants paying, and not in coin.

rows.title: A name and a place
rows.truth: A dying man gave {pc} a name and a place and died before saying why.
rows.seen: A dying stranger grips your sleeve, says a name and a street, and goes.

rows.title: Kill a good man
rows.truth: {npc} offers a year's wages to kill a priest who has done nothing but good.
rows.seen: {npc} offers you a year's wages to kill a priest. By every account, a kind one.

rows.title: A body in your room
rows.truth: Someone killed a stranger in {pc}'s rented room and sent for the watch.
rows.seen: You wake to a dead stranger on your floor and boots on the stairs.

rows.title: A sealed box
rows.truth: {npc} pays {pc} to carry a sealed box to Trein and never open it.
rows.seen: {npc} offers good money to carry a sealed box to Trein, unopened.

rows.title: Mistaken
rows.truth: A stranger mistakes {pc} for the killer they hired.
rows.seen: A nervous man presses half a purse on you and says the rest comes when it's done.

rows.title: A test
rows.truth: The {faction} offers {pc} a place, if they break a shopkeeper's arm first.
rows.seen: The {faction} will take you in. First, a shopkeeper who won't pay needs a lesson.

rows.title: A ransom
rows.truth: {npc}'s daughter has been taken, and they want {pc} to carry the ransom.
rows.seen: {npc} begs you to carry a ransom. They don't trust the watch.

rows.title: The heir
rows.truth: A lawyer insists {pc} is heir to a dead lord's lands. The lord's brother disagrees.
rows.seen: A lawyer says you've inherited land. The dead lord's brother sends his regards with a knife.

rows.title: A deserter's map
rows.truth: A deserter has a map to the hidden armory under Adlmyr.
rows.seen: A deserter offers to sell you a map of Adlmyr's old armory.

rows.title: Before the witch-finder
rows.truth: A Ley-gifted woman needs out of {town} before the witch-finder comes.
rows.seen: A woman asks you to get her out of {town} tonight, and won't say why.

rows.title: A forged writ
rows.truth: {npc} wants a forged writ delivered to the garrison.
rows.seen: {npc} wants a letter carried to the garrison commander. The seal looks almost right.

rows.title: A broken seal
rows.truth: A priest breaks the seal of confession: {npc} means to murder their spouse.
rows.seen: A shaking priest tells you what {npc} confessed, and begs you to stop it.

rows.title: An old enemy
rows.truth: Someone from {pc}'s past is in {town}, and remembers.
rows.seen: A face across the market you hoped never to see again. They've seen you too.

rows.title: A shard of the axe
rows.truth: A shard of Gor'gel's crystal axe was stolen from the temple.
rows.seen: The temple's holiest relic is gone, and three different people want you to find it.

rows.title: The plague cart
rows.truth: The plague-cart driver takes the living too, for a fee.
rows.seen: The plague cart rattles past. Something in the pile is moving.

rows.title: Bones under the floor
rows.truth: Work on the inn turned up bones, and the innkeeper wants them gone.
rows.seen: The innkeeper offers free rooms for a month if you'll carry some sacks out of town tonight.

rows.title: The captain's bargain
rows.truth: A Kadragar captain offers passage for silence about her hold.
rows.seen: A goblin captain will take you anywhere, free, if you never ask what's below decks.

rows.title: Dying fathers
rows.truth: Melton Ilvar's agent wants {pc} to find a son. The son's father is dying, as every father in that line has died, young.
rows.seen: A well-paid agent wants a missing heir found before his father dies. He says it's urgent; it always is.
